head: 213ac9bcd8b0fb755bfe05c0f7e473274e48544b
scope: git diff origin/master...HEAD: 45 files and related call chains; excluded all user changes in original 9417 working tree

findings.title: Prevent a settled PJAX script request from starting its local fallback
findings.trigger: A CDN entry/masonry script is still in flight when execute is cancelled or its 8-second timeout rejects. The removed script subsequently emits a native loading error (delayed HTTP 404 reproduces this in Chromium).
findings.actual: finish removes the node and rejects the Promise but leaves its onerror callback installed. That callback does not check a settled flag or signal.aborted, so it creates and appends the local script after execute already failed. The fallback executes once on the surviving document.
findings.expected: A completed/cancelled/expired script job must never start any new fallback request or initialize the page afterwards. Native errors before settlement must still retry locally once.
findings.impact: Late local page entry or masonry code can initialize a cancelled navigation after its owner has settled, create obsolete page modules/listeners, and interfere with the surviving page. Removing an in-flight script does not reliably suppress its eventual native error, so this is observable browser behavior rather than a synthetic-only event sequence. Timeout normally starts a full navigation, but the unwanted fallback can execute while that full navigation is still pending; same-page history cancellation can leave the current document alive.
reproduction: Run bun /private/tmp/halo-review-native.mjs outside the network sandbox. It extracts and TypeScript-transpiles the exact scriptCopy/execute functions from this HEAD without altering them, serves a private loopback HTTP fixture, and launches an independent headless Chrome with its own temporary profile.

Cancellation case: start the remote script, abort after 100 ms, then return native HTTP 404 after 600 ms. execute rejects Navigation cancelled, the script list is empty at settlement, but the local fallback is then fetched/appended/executed: fallbackExecutions=1.

Timeout case: return remote HTTP 404 after 8500 ms. execute rejects Script timed out at 8000 ms with no script node remaining; the local fallback is subsequently fetched/appended/executed: fallbackExecutions=1.
Control: a native HTTP 404 after 100 ms without cancellation retries the local script once and resolves successfully.
findings.suggestion: Add a once-only settled/done flag in execute. finish must set it and clear the current node's onload/onerror callbacks. Check settled and signal.aborted before fallback creation, and detach handlers from the failed remote node before replacing it. Keep the existing no-retry-on-timeout behavior. Add a regression using real delayed native failure or explicit saved-handler replay after abort/timeout.

Native reproduction uses extracted, unmodified execute/scriptCopy from the reviewed SHA rather than a full Halo end-to-end route. It proves executable late fallback and cancellation/timeout ordering, while the full page state corruption impact follows from entry/masonry initialization call chains.
No physical devices, Safari/Firefox, live third-party services, public CDN mirrors, plugin ecosystem combinations or complete 1.0 acceptance.
